task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: 'Carry the box to the exit' requires the box to be in the agent's hands when reaching the exit, but the only goal clause is Existence(at_exit), which is satisfied by reaching the exit with empty hands — the machine pays the exit reward (u1 -> u2) whenever holding_box is true, yet at_exit with !holding_box breaks the ChainResponse instead of being the carried goal being met. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (the task phrase 'carry the box to the exit' states it; at_exit is a one-step condition, so it closes with holding_box on the last step). Keep Existence(at_exit) and the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which correctly captures 'pick it up again on your very next move'.

calls.candidate: hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), hard Existence(at_exit), hard Response(at_exit, holding_box)
calls.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) forces the box to be held on the exit step (carrying the box to the exit), and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'if the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' — since picking up on the next step makes holding_box true.
